name: anti_windup_clamp
description: A huge, sustained error (setpoint=100, measurement=0 for the whole run) would mathematically drive the integrator far past any sane bound. PID.c clamps it to [limMinInt, limMaxInt] = [-5, 5] every step (anti-windup). This checks that clamp directly on integrator_state -- something the declared XML dependencies cannot tell you, only reading the clamping code can. Verified: integrator_state reaches exactly 5.0 and holds there.

metadata.derived_from: src/PID.c PIDController_Update, the anti-wind-up clamp on pid->integrator
metadata.author: Claude (Sonnet 5), reading the source directly

checks.description: limMinInt/limMaxInt are both 5 in magnitude by default; this is the anti-windup invariant itself.
